summary: Birth date missing or invalid placeholder (00/00/0000)
root_cause: Legacy system allowed placeholder and blank DOB at registration
resolution: Route to error queue; Registration to verify DOB from insurance card or ID before Mock 2

summary: Sex coded U or blank in legacy
root_cause: Optional field in legacy registration screen
resolution: Load as Unknown; Registration to update at next visit; add as a required field in the target system

summary: 10 probable duplicate patient pairs (same name + DOB + phone under different IDs)
root_cause: No duplicate check in legacy system at registration
resolution: HIM to review each pair and merge before load; add EMPI duplicate rule in target

summary: ICD-9 codes 780.79 and 799.9 missing from crosswalk
root_cause: Crosswalk built from top-volume codes only
resolution: Clinical informaticist approved 780.79 -> R53.83 and 799.9 -> R69; add to crosswalk for Mock 2

summary: Problem-list rows with no matching patient
root_cause: Patients purged from legacy demographics but child rows retained
resolution: Exclude from load; log in error report for HIM

summary: Phone or ZIP set to NULL by cleansing rules
root_cause: Placeholder phones (000-000-0000) and 4-digit ZIPs in legacy
resolution: Accepted by data owner; patients will update at next visit through the portal or registration
